mentions.name: wasm2go
mentions.description: A Wasm-to-Go transpiler that converts WebAssembly modules into Go code. The project is adding support for the threads/atomics proposal and has been used to transpile SQLite to Go as well as other C, C++, Zig, and Perl libraries to Go.
mentions.audience: A Go developers transpiling libraries written in other languages (C, C++, Zig, Perl) into Go.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Adding support for the threads/atomics proposal to my Wasm to Go transpiler:
https://github.com/ncruces/wasm2go

Since I started it a couple of months ago, it's been used by me to transpile SQLite to Go, and by some other folks to transpile other C, C++, Zig and even Perl libraries to Go.
